subject: Pilot spend corridor validation — quick recap & action items
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot spend corridor validation — quick recap & action items

Thanks Alex — great conversation earlier. Short recap and proposed next steps so everyone has the same signal: 

Call highlights
- Primary goal: validate economics for a 3-month pilot that exercises generation and embeddings for our in-product assistant.
- Estimated steady-state consumption: 25M tokens/month generation + 5M tokens/month embeddings (first-pass estimate).
- Customer budget target: in the low tens of thousands per month; Alex to confirm a precise band.

Proposed pricing/commit snapshot (for discussion)
- Pilot commitment proposal: 600M tokens over 3 months (approximately 200M/month).
- Baseline list unit: $/1M tokens shown in the attached pricing-matrix.pdf — ballpark effective pricing for the configuration we discussed is $900–$1,050 per 1M gen tokens; embeddings are billed separately at a lower effective rate.
- With intelligent prefix caching and batching (likely for the assistant), we expect effective $/1M to drop ~25–35% on typical request distributions.

Ask from AcmeOps
1) Can you confirm an approximate monthly procurement band (e.g., $10k–$25k, $25k–$50k) so we can align commitment levels?
2) Procurement triggers: is PO required at start of pilot, or only for >$X per month? What are lead time constraints?
3) Any internal pricing targets (target $/1M tokens) we should be aware of to tune the proposal?

Next steps
- I will send a 1-page mutual action plan (MAF_v1.xlsx) and a simple pricing comparison table by EOD.
- Karthik/Connor: internal note — if AcmeOps signals a sub-$15k/month band we may need to keep it as pay-as-you-go pilot; over $15k/month we can propose a small reserved discount.

Attachments: MAF_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft), pricing-matrix.pdf

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine_liu@redwood.com] | +1 415-555-0187

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeops.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeops.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmeops.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot spend corridor validation — quick recap & action items

Thanks Jasmine — very helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Budget band: leadership is comfortable with an initial pilot spend of $12k–$18k/month. That puts us below the $25k tier but above the small experiment lane.
2) Procurement rules: our procurement team issues a PO for any vendor spend > $15k per month. If monthly spend is <= $15k we can do a P-card or an internal charge process (faster). PO lead time is typically 7–10 business days once a request is submitted; legal review may add time if there are SaaS T&Cs to negotiate.
3) Pricing target: product leadership wants effective $/1M token closer to $800–$900 for generation after factoring caching, but they understand list can be higher depending on model. Embeddings target: ~$250–$350 per 1M embeddings.

We are comfortable signing a short MAF and starting a small pilot under the $15k/month lane if Redwood can keep the initial month under that number with clear instrumentation and spend visibility. If the pilot shows promising signals, we will consider increasing the monthly band and moving to a committed slab.

Cc'ing Maya from procurement to loop in timing and PO process.

Best,
Alex
Alex Turner | Head of Product, AcmeOps
alex.turner@acmeops.com | +1 206-555-0133

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot spend corridor validation — quick recap & action items

Alex — perfect, that band is clear and useful. A few quick points and an example cost run so procurement can see how the math works in practice: 

Operational proposal for sub-$15k pilot lane
- Start with a 30-day pilot capped at $15k. We will enable dashboards with token-level telemetry and spend alerts at $5k increments.
- Model selection: recommend Redwood-medium-8q for generation (good latency/cost balance) and Redwood-embed-small for embeddings.

Sample run-rate math (illustrative)
- Estimated nominal generation consumption: 25M tokens/month. List price for chosen model: $950 per 1M tokens -> raw cost = 25 * $950 = $23,750.
- Factoring caching/batching (measured on similar customers): realistic effective consumption drop to ~11–13M tokens/month -> effective cost = 13 * $950 = $12,350.
- Embeddings (5M tokens/month) at $300 per 1M = $1,500.
- Combined effective pilot monthly = ~$13,850. Under the $15k cap.

So the ask we heard today (band $12k–$18k) maps to: 
- Conservative no-cache case: $25k+ (outside pilot lane)
- Realistic cache-enabled case: $12k–$15k (inside PO threshold)

Action items
- Jasmine: share the MAF and a simple spend/telemetry checklist (will attach in next mail).
- Alex/Maya: confirm whether procurement needs the initial PO for the pilot or if the P-card option is preferable to expedite start.
- Karthik/Connor: once Alex confirms, can you confirm whether we can approve a pilot discount to hit an effective $/1M of $850 for the first 30 days (internal approval path required)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call with procurement to walk through telemetry and SLA expectations if that helps.

Jasmine

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot spend corridor validation — approve pilot discount?

Jasmine / Connor — quick internal:
- I'm OK to approve a targeted pilot concession to get the deal running as long as AcmeOps signs the MAF and accepts a clear cap of $15k for month 1.
- Approvals required: Revenue OPS sign-off (done), Finance needs a one-line approval to accept month-1 discount (Connor to flag), and Legal only if T&C redlines are requested.
- If AcmeOps comes in at the $12k/month realized band we keep pay-as-you-go with spend alerts; if they hit >$15k/mo we move to a reserved slab pricing discussion for month 2.

Connor — can you confirm the finance note and whether we need an internal ledger code to bill a PO < $20k? If not, I'll push the concession.

Karthik
VP, Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
